worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.summary: A heavy open-hand slam thrown with a full lunge: double damage against a sleeping target, and the hit wakes it up (leaving it briefly staggering). The aftershock option shakes a ring around the impact, catching and waking nearby foes too.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.description: The damage %1$s of this slam; doubled against a sleeping target.
Lunge %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, collision radius %3$s blocks, shove %4$s blocks.
A woken target staggers for %1$s. The aftershock reaches %2$s blocks and deals %3$s of the damage.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.use.1: Double damage in the sleep window
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.use.2: Wake a whole group with the aftershock
On: the slam shakes a ring that also hits other enemies inside for a 0.4 share and wakes any sleepers among them, but this hit is ×0.85 and the cooldown is 4 ticks longer. Off: a focused slam at ×1.08.
Only close in when the target is within this distance; higher chases sleeping targets further out.
When on, a sleeping target is woken first (the doubling window); when off it is used only when no other move is available.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.growth.0: From level %1$s: slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.growth.1: From level %1$s: slam power %2$s, lunge distance %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.shock.on: Aftershock: the slam shakes a ring, this hit is held back.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.shock.off: Focused: one target only, full damage.
